1842 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
299 days = 365 - 66 days, so subtracting 299 days from 1842-11-29 goes back into early 1842.  
1842-11-29 minus 299 days = 1842-02-03 (since Jan 31, Feb 28 → 59 days from start of year, 299 days back from Nov 29 lands on Feb 3).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1842-02-03
